comment: The cutoff CV jack is scaled exactly as the V/OCT jack is, by two raised to the volts, so both are marked as pitch. The difference is the attenuverter default: V/OCT comes up at full positive and the cutoff CV attenuverter at zero. The corner is clamped to 20Hz..20000Hz after both are applied.
